title: Replace release.yml with obsidian-workflows reusable release
description:
.github/workflows/release.yml hand-rolls build + actions/attest@v4 + `gh release create --draft`. Missing vs `obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1`:
- No lint or scanner-lint gate (release mode forces scanner ESLint + Stylelint).
- No manifest.json version <-> tag consistency check (src/release.ts); `tags: '*'` accepts `v1.0.0` while .npmrc/AGENTS.md require bare semver tags.
- No manifest/README/LICENSE/registry validation before publishing.
- actions/checkout@v6 / setup-node@v6 (current @v7).
Keep: draft release, permissions contents/id-token/attestations write.
acceptance_criteria: release.yml calls the reusable workflow (or the action with mode: release) with the three write permissions; a test tag produces a draft release with attested main.js (+styles.css if kept) and manifest.json.

title: Replace lint.yml with obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows PR checks
description:
.github/workflows/lint.yml (named "Node.js build") runs npm ci/build/lint only. Gaps vs obsidian-workflows README:
- No manifest schema/policy, versions.json, README, LICENSE, registry-collision, bundle preflight or scanner-lint checks (all provided by `obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows@v1`).
- No `permissions:` block -> default GITHUB_TOKEN scope; README prescribes `contents: read`.
- Triggers on push AND pull_request for all branches -> duplicate runs per PR.
- Matrix includes Node 20.x (EOL 2026-04-30); action enforces >=20, default 24.
- actions/checkout@v6, setup-node@v6; README uses @v7 (latest v7.0.1 / v7.1.0).
Suggested: `uses: obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows@v1` with `scanner-lint: true`; flip `strict: true` once sample/identity issues are closed (policy findings are warnings by default). Update AGENTS.md line "A GitHub Action automatically lints every commit on all branches" to match.
acceptance_criteria: CI workflow uses obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows@v1 with read-only permissions and current action majors; runs on PRs (and pushes to default branch if desired); AGENTS.md describes the new CI.
notes: Grill 2026-10-31 decision: enable strict: true from the start (not a later flip). Land after draidus-7pv.2, .3, .5.
close_reason: Strict obsidian-workflows CI passed (run 41227099682); dependencies complete

title: Fix eslint.config.mts: manifest/LICENSE/package.json rules never run
description:
eslint.config.mts (identical to upstream sample) silently skips three recommended checks:
1. manifest.json: `npx eslint manifest.json` -> "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". `obsidianmd/validate-manifest` is only registered for **/*.{ts,...,js} globs, so `allowDefaultProject: ['manifest.json']` + `extraFileExtensions: ['.json']` are dead config. Probe config (files: ['manifest.json'], parser: typescript-eslint parser, extraFileExtensions .json) surfaced 3 hidden findings (see manifest issue).
2. LICENSE: never linted. Probe with `PlainTextParser` from eslint-plugin-obsidianmd/dist/lib/plainTextParser.js surfaced the Dynalist holder finding.
3. package.json is in globalIgnores, which disables the recommended `depend/ban-dependencies` block (files: ['package.json']). Currently clean with --no-ignore, but future banned deps would go unnoticed.
Also:
- Local `npm run lint` fails with 2 parse errors from `apm_modules/_local/...` (gitignored locally, not ignored by eslint). Add `apm_modules` (and other local tooling dirs) to globalIgnores.
- `globals.browser` spread is redundant: recommended config already sets browser + Obsidian globals.
- `eslint .` exits 0 on warnings; community Scorecard counts warnings. Consider `eslint . --max-warnings 0`.
- Ignoring versions.json/tsconfig.json is redundant (no config matches .json).
acceptance_criteria: `npx eslint manifest.json LICENSE package.json` lints all three (no 'ignored'/'no matching configuration' warnings); `npm run lint` locally has no apm_modules parse errors; config follows obsidianmd/eslint-plugin docs/configuration.md structure.

title: Remove sample code from src/ and styles.css
description:
`npm run lint` fails with 6 sample-related errors:
- src/main.ts:17 and :104, src/settings.ts:4 and :12 `obsidianmd/sample-names` (MyPlugin, SampleModal, MyPluginSettings, SampleSettingTab).
- src/main.ts:84 `obsidianmd/no-sample-code` (registerInterval).
- src/main.ts:85 `obsidianmd/rule-custom-message` [no-console] console.log in interval.
Also sample behavior not flagged by rules but shipped to users: ribbon icon 'dice' showing a Notice, status bar text (comment notes it does not work on mobile; manifest says isDesktopOnly false), a document-wide click handler that raises a Notice on every click, three demo commands, SampleModal ("Woah!"), setting "Settings #1" / "It's a secret", empty `onunload() {}`.
settings.ts imports the default class from main.ts (circular main<->settings); use `import type`.
styles.css is a comment-only placeholder saying to delete it if unused.
AGENTS.md: keep main.ts lifecycle-only, feature code in modules.
acceptance_criteria: src/ contains only a minimal lifecycle main.ts (no settings tab/module, commands, ribbon, status bar, click handler, interval, or placeholder structure); styles.css deleted; npm run lint reports zero sample-names/no-sample-code/no-console findings; npm run build passes; plugin loads in Obsidian.
notes: Grill 2026-10-31 decision: delete the settings tab and settings module entirely (no real settings exist) and delete styles.css. Add no placeholder structure (no actions/ dir, command registry, etc.). main.ts = minimal lifecycle only. Acceptance's 'settings module' clause is superseded.
close_reason: Empty plugin loaded in Obsidian; CLI confirms enabled=true, loaded=true, id=draidus; build and lint pass

title: Fix LICENSE holder and invalid SPDX id in package.json
description:
- LICENSE: "Copyright (C) 2020-2026 by Dynalist Inc." -> eslint `obsidianmd/validate-license`: 'Please change the copyright holder from "Dynalist Inc." to your name.' (hidden today: rule never runs, see eslint-config issue). Year is current (2026), so only the holder fails.
- package.json `license: "0-BSD"` is not a valid SPDX id (correct: `0BSD`). obsidian-workflows src/repo-checks.ts OSI set contains `0BSD`, so it emits policy warning `license-not-osi-approved`.
acceptance_criteria: LICENSE holder is the owner; package.json `license` is a valid SPDX id matching LICENSE text; validate-license and obsidian-workflows license check clean.
notes:
Recheck 2026-10-31 #2 @ 5f60c85: LICENSE and package.json unchanged since previous recheck.
Done: holder no longer Dynalist; validate-license (forced probe) passes.
Remaining:
- LICENSE titled "MIT License" but body is the 0BSD grant (no MIT attribution clause). GitHub API detects 0BSD; package.json says "MIT". Use canonical MIT text, or set package.json "license": "0BSD".
- Holder "AvogadroSG1 Inc." (template "Inc." carry-over); use real legal name/handle.
- Year range 2020-2026 inherited from template; use 2026.
Grill 2026-10-31 decision: replace LICENSE with canonical MIT text, line 'Copyright (c) 2026 Peter O'Connor' (drop 'AvogadroSG1 Inc.' and 2020- range); package.json license stays 'MIT'.

title: Replace sample identity in manifest.json, versions.json, package.json
description:
manifest.json is the sample template's. Findings:
- eslint `obsidianmd/validate-manifest` (when actually run, see eslint-config issue): "The 'id' property cannot contain 'plugin'.", "The 'name' property cannot contain 'plugin'.", "The 'description' property cannot contain 'obsidian'."
- obsidian-workflows src/manifest.ts policy errors: `manifest-id-banned-word` (sample-plugin), `manifest-disallowed-name` (Sample Plugin), `manifest-description-brand-name` (description contains "Obsidian"), `manifest-url-obsidian` for authorUrl and fundingUrl.
- id `sample-plugin` != plugin folder `draidus`.
- versions.json maps 1.0.0 -> 1.0.0 (sample minAppVersion).

notes:
Grill 2026-10-31 decision (supersedes earlier rechecks; manifest identity change is committed in 1f99238; id/name/author/authorUrl pass, fundingUrl removed).
Remaining:

- manifest.json minAppVersion -> 1.13.0; versions.json -> {"1.0.0": "1.13.0"}.

title: Decide plugin identity: id, name, author, license, minAppVersion
description:
Several starter fixes are blocked on owner choices that are permanent or user-visible:
- Plugin `id` (never changes after release). Folder is `draidus`; AGENTS.md says the id should match the folder for local dev. Current `sample-plugin` violates both linters (contains "plugin").
- Display `name` (must not contain "Obsidian"/"Plugin"; must not start "Obsi"/end "dian"), `description` (no "Obsidian", no "This plugin", ends with . ? ! or ), <=250 chars).
- `author`, `authorUrl`, `fundingUrl` (both URLs currently point at obsidian.md -> obsidian-workflows `manifest-url-obsidian` policy error). Drop `fundingUrl` if no funding.
- License + copyright holder (currently 0BSD text, holder "Dynalist Inc.").
- `minAppVersion`: currently 1.0.0. >=1.13.0 allows dropping the legacy settings `display()`; <1.13.0 requires keeping it (settings-tab/require-display).
- `isDesktopOnly`: currently false.
acceptance_criteria: Values recorded in this issue's notes for: id, name, description, author, authorUrl, fundingUrl (or none), license SPDX id + holder, minAppVersion, isDesktopOnly.
notes:
Recheck 2026-10-31 (from committed manifest.json/package.json/LICENSE @ 03b5913):
- id: draidus (matches folder)
- name: Draidus
- author: AvogadroSG1; authorUrl: https://github.com/AvogadroSG1
- fundingUrl: https://github.com/AvogadroSG1/draidus (repo page, not a donation link; guidelines say omit fundingUrl if no donations)
- minAppVersion: 1.0.0 (=> settings tab must keep display(); see .8)
- isDesktopOnly: true
- license: package.json says MIT, but LICENSE body is 0BSD text -> unresolved, tracked in .3
- description: current value fails both linters -> rewording tracked in .2
Grill 2026-10-31 decision: minAppVersion 1.0.0 -> 1.13.0 (single settings path, no legacy display(); versions.json still serves old builds if ever raised further). isDesktopOnly stays true (likely OAuth loopback needs Node; false->true later would drop users). License: MIT, holder Peter O'Connor, 2026. Description: 'Turn notes into actions on external services.'
close_reason: Identity chosen (see notes); description wording and license text follow-ups live in .2 and .3

title: Starter updates
description:
Audit (2026-10-31) of this starter against obsidianmd/eslint-plugin (v0.4.2) and obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows (v1.2.3).

Baseline: every starter file is byte-identical to obsidianmd/obsidian-sample-plugin@master (diffed via gh api). So all findings are inherited template defaults, not local regressions.

Observed:
- `npm run build`: passes.
- `npm run lint`: exit 1, 8 errors + 1 warning in src/ (sample-names x4, no-sample-code, no-console, prefer-setting-definitions) + 2 parse errors from local apm_modules/.
- validate-manifest / validate-license are never executed by the current eslint config; forcing them yields 4 more findings.
- obsidian-workflows policy findings: manifest id/name/description/authorUrl/fundingUrl, README sample template, package.json license `0-BSD` not OSI/SPDX.
- Workflows are hand-rolled and do not use obsidianmd/obsidian-workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Done = empty plugin that loads (no commands, settings tab, ribbon, status bar, styles.css); npm run build, npm run lint, obsidian-workflows PR checks (strict: true) and release workflow pass. Feature work lives in draidus-z4c.
notes: Grill 2026-10-31 decision: epic scope is the clean empty starter only; first Action moved to draidus-z4c. Glossary created (GLOSSARY.md). No ADRs warranted.
close_reason: All child tickets complete; build, lint, strict CI, release workflow, and Obsidian plugin load verified

title: Enforce npm checks in Git hooks
description:
## Why
Pre-commit and pre-push currently run only Beads commands. Make the available lint and production build checks fail closed in both hooks, and activate the tracked Beads hook directory through an npm lifecycle setup script that does not depend on bd. The plugin currently has no test suite or behavior suitable for meaningful app tests; do not add fake tests.

## Acceptance
- npm install configures local core.hooksPath to .beads/hooks in this repository's Git worktree and no-ops outside a Git worktree.
- Pre-commit and pre-push run npm run lint and npm run build after Beads handling, independent of bd availability.
- npm check failures block commits/pushes.
- README explains the hooks and current absence of tests.
- Verify successful checks and intentional failure behavior.
close_reason: Added bd-independent hook activation and fail-closed lint/build checks; verified both hooks and failure paths. No app test suite exists.

title: First real setting uses getSettingDefinitions()
description:
src/settings.ts:12 warns `obsidianmd/settings-tab/prefer-setting-definitions`: without getSettingDefinitions() settings don't appear in 1.13+ settings search. Rules interplay with minAppVersion:
- minAppVersion < 1.13.0: implement getSettingDefinitions() AND keep display() (require-display).
- minAppVersion >= 1.13.0: implement getSettingDefinitions() and delete display() (no-deprecated-display); refresh via this.update() not this.display().
Keep all persisted data inside plugin.settings (auto-persist clobbers sibling saveData keys).
acceptance_criteria: When the first real setting is added, the settings tab implements getSettingDefinitions() with no display() (minAppVersion 1.13.0); lint reports zero settings-tab/* findings; setting renders, persists and appears in settings search.
notes: Grill 2026-10-31 decision: re-scoped. No settings exist after draidus-7pv.5, so implementing declarative settings now is empty scaffolding. Moved to draidus-z4c; build it with the first real setting.

title: Refresh devDependencies and tsconfig
description:
`npm outdated` (2026-10-31):
- `obsidian: "latest"`: lockfile frozen at 1.12.3 while latest is 1.14.4; `latest` makes fresh installs non-reproducible and 1.12.3 lacks `getSettingDefinitions` (0 matches in obsidian.d.ts). Pin a caret range (>= the minAppVersion-era API you target).
- eslint-plugin-obsidianmd lock 0.4.0 -> 0.4.2 (range ^0.4.0 permits it).
- typescript-eslint 8.59.2 -> 8.72.1, globals 17.6 -> 17.13, @eslint/js/eslint 9.39.4 -> 9.39.5 (eslint 10 is out; plugin peer is eslint >=9.19, @eslint/js ^9.30 -> stay on 9 unless plugin supports 10).
- esbuild pinned exact 0.25.5 (latest 0.28.2). npm 11 `allowScripts` warns esbuild postinstall is not approved; build still works via optional platform package, but approve it in package.json to silence/ensure binary install.
- tsconfig `moduleResolution: "node"` (node10) is deprecated from TS 6; use "bundler" with esbuild. `inlineSourceMap`/`inlineSources` are moot under `tsc -noEmit`.
acceptance_criteria: package-lock refreshed; no `latest` specifiers; obsidian types include getSettingDefinitions; `npm ci && npm run build && npm run lint` pass with no new findings.
notes: Grill 2026-10-31 decision: pin obsidian devDependency to ~1.13 to match minAppVersion 1.13.0, so APIs newer than the floor are not silently available.

title: Rewrite README.md from sample template
description:
README.md is the sample plugin's. obsidian-workflows src/repo-checks.ts:
- `readme-sample-template` (policy error, >=2 phrases): contains "This is a sample plugin for Obsidian", "This project uses TypeScript to provide type checking and documentation", "Releasing new releases".
- `readme-placeholder` (warn): `your-plugin-name`.
- `readme-name-mismatch` (warn): first heading "Obsidian Sample Plugin" must match manifest name.
Per AGENTS.md, README must also disclose any network use/telemetry if added later.
acceptance_criteria: README first heading equals manifest name; no sample phrases or placeholders; covers install, usage, dev (npm run dev/build/lint) and release steps.
